before: The order of concurrent split siblings read only the text each new paragraph copies. When a paragraph of such a run was deleted, a paragraph split off it that held other text could move after its sibling.
after: A paragraph that a split creates records, in its shared record field splitPoints, the listing entry it was written for, the paragraph it split, and the identity of the first character it moved, after the split points of the paragraph it split (at most four); any other paragraph an edit creates, as a break at a paragraph's end, takes the split points of the paragraph listed right before it. A block that an edit moves right after a concurrent split sibling the order moves takes that sibling's split points, and when an edit removes such a sibling's entry, the block listed after it from its place takes them, so it keeps the sibling's place. The order counts a paragraph as a split only at the entry its field names, so a block a move, an undo, or a redo lists again takes no part where it now stands. The order of concurrent split siblings compares the nearest split of one paragraph two blocks both name, by where those first moved characters stand in the text they came from, and reads the copied text only when they name none in common or the same character. A paragraph split off a deleted sibling keeps that sibling's place.
reason: The field is a new key on a paragraph record. The edit that lists the paragraph at a new entry writes it, in the transaction that lists it; a later edit that lists it elsewhere can write it again for that entry, which every replica reads alike, because each value names the entry it belongs to. Released readers would not read it and would order the run by text alone, which is the repairVersion 3 change these records already make; replicas with repairVersion 2 refuse these rooms. A paragraph without the field, as a release without it wrote, falls back to the text rule, so rooms of this format created before the field order as before. sharedSchemaVersion does not change: the field is an optional key on a record that replicas of this format write once and others only read, no existing field changes meaning, and a paragraph without it orders by the earlier rule.
